stb_vorbis.c
============
Ogg Vorbis audio decoder, version 1.22, by Sean Barrett and contributors.
Source: https://github.com/nothings/stb (stb_vorbis.c), unmodified.

License: dual licensed, choose either one (the text is at the end of
stb_vorbis.c):
  - MIT License, Copyright (c) 2017 Sean Barrett, or
  - Public Domain (unlicense.org).

Use in this project: decodes .ogg files that sound mods place in their sound/
folder (port/hal/sdat/sd_audio.cpp). It is compiled into the game only through
port/hal/sdat/vorbis_impl.cpp, with STB_VORBIS_NO_STDIO and
STB_VORBIS_NO_PUSHDATA_API defined (memory decoding only).
